epistemic_status: PRODUCT SCAFFOLD built against fixtures. Carries no scientific claim and must not imply a model has been promoted.

promotion_claim.statement: Nothing in this node implies a model has been promoted. The incumbent D_ewma_shrunk is frozen and no challenger exists. The monitor treats model_version and artifact hashes as opaque snapshot data and can render a frame produced by any model or by none.
promotion_claim.mechanically_enforced_by: TESTS.py section D: 50 arm/experiment/artifact identifiers read from arm_registry.jsonl plus the frozen incumbent's arm name plus its two MAE figures must not appear on the product surface. The check passes.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: stale inputs, missing lineups and failed jobs are each individually visible
evidence: fixtures/stale_input.json -> exactly one INPUT row STALE (odds_feed, age 2520.0 s against a 600 s limit), the other three remain OK, and no LINEUP_* or JOB_* code is raised (TESTS.py [A1], 5 checks)

fixtures/missing_lineup.json -> exactly one LINEUP row MISSING, n_players null rather than fabricated, and the OTHER team's projection still renders: the gap is entity-scoped (TESTS.py [A2], 5 checks)
fixtures/failed_job.json -> three distinct job statuses in one frame, FAILED / DID_NOT_RUN / LATE, not collapsed (TESTS.py [A3], 6 checks)
ROLLBACK is its own panel carrying state, serving version, superseded version, changed_at, reason and initiator
fixtures/rollback_active.json -> ROLLBACK_ACTIVE banner raised while still serving; both version strings appear in the rendered panel
fixtures/rollback_pending.json -> a rollback in flight suppresses everything because the serving version is not established
an absent rollback block evaluates to UNKNOWN, never NONE (TESTS.py [B], 9 checks)

acceptance_criteria.criterion: a silent failure is impossible: absence of data renders as an explicit alert
evidence: fixtures/silent_failure_attempt.json: a snapshot carrying two plausible projections and no evidence of any kind renders zero numbers, 15 CRITICAL alerts, and the numerals 81.25 and 79.5 appear nowhere in the rendered panel
evaluate(None), evaluate({}), evaluate([1,2,3]), evaluate('everything is fine') and a wrong-schema object all return SUPPRESSED with alerts and never raise

exhaustive ablation sweep: deleting each of 132 snapshot locations in turn never increases the number of rendered numbers; 58 of the 132 deletions suppress a projection; no deletion reduces output without raising an alert
null sweep over the same 132 locations: nulling any field is never rewarded with a number
a snapshot older than its max age suppresses everything, so a frozen dashboard cannot keep showing the last good frame
an ALERT display cell does not carry the underlying value at all, so the renderer physically cannot print it

measurements.what: live capture sources bound in the repository
measurements.method: measure_repo_facts.py parses SOURCE_BINDING.json and counts domains[*].bound independently of the file's own n_bound field; both agree
measurements.consequence: pointed at the program as it stands today, this monitor shows a wall of UNBOUND and zero projections. fixtures/unbound_reality.json reproduces exactly that: 16 CRITICAL alerts, 0 of 2 projections rendered.

measurements.method: measure_repo_facts.py regex over the defect table
measurements.consequence: D-a and D-d are the late-record-reads-as-healthy shape; the evaluator downgrades a SUCCEEDED job that completed after its own cutoff to LATE on timestamps alone. D-b is the silent discovery miss; the expected_projections mechanism is the monitor-side analogue.

measurements.what: occurrences of 'rollback' in the program, outside this node
measurements.method: measure_repo_facts.py case-insensitive scan of experiments/player_program, excluding this node's own directory and SEALED_RESULTS
measurements.consequence: NEGATIVE RESULT. Every hit is the graph restating this node's own acceptance criterion (PROGRAM_GRAPH.json, the generated prompt, seed_graph.py, the generated status and index reports). No rollback mechanism, procedure, log, state file or version-pinning convention exists anywhere in the program. The rollback panel is therefore a specification of what a rollback record would have to contain, not a view over an existing one.

contradictions_found.statement: The node brief and PROGRAM_GRAPH.json require that 'rollback state is visible', which reads as though a rollback state exists to be surfaced. It does not: zero non-self-referential occurrences of the word exist in the program.
contradictions_found.resolved_how: Not resolved by invention. The panel is built and specified; it is fed by fixtures only, and the report states plainly that no producer exists.

contradictions_found.statement: The concurrently running product node U10_PREDICTION_API_SCHEMA emits warning codes INPUT_MISSING (prediction_response_schema.py:388), INPUT_STALE (:398) and JOB_FAILED (:408), which match this node's codes exactly, but uses JOB_NOT_RUN (:418) where this node uses JOB_DID_NOT_RUN. It also carries no rollback vocabulary at all.
contradictions_found.resolved_how: Not resolved here. U10 is in flight and unvalidated; editing it is outside this node's write scope and coupling to unvalidated concurrent output would be worse than the divergence. Recorded as a proposed shared-contract change for the coordinator.

contradictions_found.kind: design observation, not a contradiction in the bytes
contradictions_found.statement: Alert SEVERITY and SUPPRESSION are separate axes, and the stale_input fixture shows why: it raises three WARNING alerts and zero CRITICAL alerts, yet serving is SUPPRESSED. A reader who equates 'no critical alerts' with 'healthy' would misread the panel.
contradictions_found.resolved_how: The serving banner is printed first and independently of severity counts, and the contract states the two axes explicitly (MONITOR_CONTRACT.md section 7).

shared_contract_changes_proposed: Align the failed-job code across the product lane: U10 uses JOB_NOT_RUN, U13 uses JOB_DID_NOT_RUN. One spelling should win. Proposed only; nothing was merged and no sibling file was touched.

Consider adopting expected_projections (an explicit per-frame obligation list) as a shared product-lane concept, so a vanished row cannot read as a complete table in the API response either. Proposed only.
could_not_establish: Whether any real producer will ever write a monitor snapshot. No snapshot producer exists in the repository and building one is outside this node's write scope.
Real staleness thresholds. Every max_age_seconds in the fixtures is invented; there is no measured refresh cadence in the program to derive one from, because zero capture domains are bound.
Whether the four D11 domains this node models as 'inputs' would in practice arrive through the D11 capture ledger or through a separate path. D11's own adapters are unbuilt.
Rollback semantics in the operational system. There is nothing to reproduce; see U13-C1.
Whether the concurrently running U11_UI_SHELL renders these panels compatibly. It was not read for behaviour and this node does not import it.

stop_conditions.statement: Nothing in this node touches the primary target, the K0 structure, the inference structure, the candidate universe, the cutoff-valid feature set or the leakage status. The monitor never reads a feature, a fold, a fit or a result; it reads timestamps, statuses and opaque version strings.
